example.task: Exercise a per-attempt credit ceiling and compute cost per accepted clip.
steps: Calculate remaining credits after each debit.
Compare the remaining balance with another 30-credit attempt.
Divide total debits by accepted clips.
example.result: The running balances were 70, 40 and 10. The fourth attempt exceeded the ceiling. One accepted clip cost 90 example credits.
example.readerImpact: Use a ceiling to prevent another attempt and count the cost of discarded results.
example.limits: Arithmetic simulation only. No vendor pricing, transaction, credit deduction or refund was tested.
